option.aefc.detectScreenOpen.tooltip: Triggers escape when a creeper ignites while you have a screen open. (inventory, chest, etc.)
option.aefc.detectBehind.tooltip: Triggers escape when a creeper ignites behind you.
option.aefc.autoLookBack.tooltip: Turns to face the creeper after reaching a safe distance.
option.aefc.shieldBlock.tooltip: Automatically raises your shield if all escape directions are blocked.
option.aefc.shieldBlockEscapeFails.toolt: Raises your shield when escape time runs out and explosion is imminent.

⚠ Note: Raising a shield takes 5 ticks (~0.25s) to fully deploy.
Enabling this may cost precious escape time and increase the risk of creeper explosions damaging builds. Choose wisely.
option.aefc.blockProtection.tooltip:
If a Creeper is likely to affect blocks on the protection list,
try placing water beneath its feet before fleeing, to prevent damage from the explosion.
option.aefc.protectedBlocks.tooltip: List of block IDs or tags to protect. (e.g. minecraft:chest)
option.aefc.allowLavaProtection.tooltip: When no water bucket is available, allow using lava to protect blocks.
⚠ Note: Lava will destroy dropped items and flammable blocks, please ensure you really need this radical feature.
